notes.title: Bug Fixes and Minor Improvements
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone, I hope you're doing well!

[/b]Here's what has been fixed or improved:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue near the end of the game where the girl in the blue-lit corridor would immediately run toward the player upon spawning, causing a bug. This should no longer happen.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor lighting adjustments have been made.[/p][/*][*][p]Several grammar mistakes have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where text elements would sometimes overlap.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]And, I’ve already started working on my second game![/b] I’ll be sharing updates with you in the near future, so make sure to follow the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45486407?snr=1_5_9_"]Patchwork Interactive Curator Page[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, feel free to reach out to me on X or via email. And if even that feels like too much work, feel free to just [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/svklmrt?snr=1_5_9_"]add me on Steam[/url] and shoot me a DM![/p][p][/p][p][b]Enjoy the game, and take care![/b][/p]

notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm back with more bug fixes. I'm trying to bring the current state of the game to the highest level possible.

- Fixed the girl running towards us as soon as she spawned in the loop where we had to collect keys.
- Flickering textures fixed.
- Some lighting issues fixed.
- Some sound issues fixed.

If you encounter any bugs or translation errors in the game, please feel free to contact me via X or email.

[b]Have fun![/b]
